_about: Public-domain John Norton (1606-1663), minister of Ipswich and then of the First Church, Boston, for the Word Hoard: The Orthodox Evangelist (1657), Abel being Dead yet Speaketh, his life of John Cotton (1658), The Heart of N-England Rent (1659), A Brief Catechisme (1660) and Three Choice and Profitable Sermons (1664), from Internet Archive scans. Charles Eliot Norton's Dante is the separate norton shelf. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 51 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jnorton-abel: Abel being dead yet speaketh; or, The life & death of that deservedly famous man of God, Mr John Cotton, : late teacher of the church of Christ, at Boston in New-England (London : printed by Tho. Newcomb for Lodowick Lloyd, and are to be sold at his shop next the Castle-Tavern in Cornhill, 1658)
